attribution.title: Cristofori, Prinsengracht 581-583, Amsterdam: former piano house and concert salon in two rebuilt warehouses
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell for the roof and back walls (CC BY 4.0): the grey stone ground and first floors with two cream-framed arched openings, CRISTOFORI in gold letters and six first-floor windows, the dark brick upper storeys in two mirrored halves with round-arched windows and railed balconies, and the corbelled parapet. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
